events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic solo album 'Imagine' in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine The Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine', an album that continues to resonate globally with its powerful message. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Musician Sting, born Gordon Sumner, celebrates his 75th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Sting
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Sting! From The Police to his incredible solo career, what's your top Sting moment?

events.title: Apple unveiled the first iPod
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, Apple introduced the first iPod. Did you have one of these game-changers, and how many songs could you fit on it?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the anniversary of the 1962 premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's Global James Bond Day! Who's your favourite 007 and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary musician John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon's Birthday
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message still inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! What's your favourite moment from his incredible career?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles gave us the iconic 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece – what are your essential tracks from it?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: We remember the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost the legendary Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul', an album that truly changed the game. What's your top track from this classic?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: We remember the life and music of John Lennon, who tragically passed away on this day in 1980.

angles.name: John Lennon Remembered
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we lost a true icon. Today, we reflect on the incredible life and music of John Lennon. His message of peace lives on.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Visionary musician David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday.

angles.name: Tribute to Bowie
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman on what would have been his 80th birthday. David Bowie's artistry continues to inspire across generations. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the one and only Elvis Presley. The King's music still reigns supreme!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Jimmy Page
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the iconic guitar wizard, Jimmy Page! What's your favourite Led Zeppelin riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic British singer Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rod Stewart
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Sir Rod Stewart, celebrating his 82nd birthday today! That distinctive voice has given us so many classics. Which one is your favourite?
